newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Dec T-bond ends higher but off session high.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Dec T-bond ends higher but off session high.

text.p: Oct 18 - U.S. Dec T-bond futures ended up but off the day's high after dealer selling materialized near the 111-20/32 high for the week. Traders call close neutral, say some may be wary before two- and five-year note auctions next week. Despite retreat from high, Dec's close is the highest all week.
